citations.narrative:
The facility did not create a medical record for the distemper and parvovirus vaccines given to two male Poodle dogs,
"Derrick" and "Austin". The facility representative contacted the licensee who reports the vaccines were given this year but
he was unaware that he needed to record that information. The Program of Vet Care prescribes for those vaccinations to
be given yearly. Complete medical records allow APHIS inspectors to ensure the facility is following their written Program
of Vet Care and the Animal Welfare Act. Correct by ensuring dealers create medical records for dogs and make the
records available for APHIS inspection. In addition to the identification of the animal, complete medical records must
include the names of all vaccines and treatments administered and the dates of administration. Correct by: August 4,
2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.

3.13(b)(3) 
   
Veterinary care for dogs. 
The facility did not create a medical record for the distemper and parvovirus vaccines given to two male Poodle dogs, 
"Derrick" and "Austin". The facility representative contacted the licensee who reports the vaccines were given this year but 
he was unaware that he needed to record that information. The Program of Vet Care prescribes for those vaccinations to 
be given yearly. Complete medical records allow APHIS inspectors to ensure the facility is following their written Program 
of Vet Care and the Animal Welfare Act. Correct by ensuring dealers create medical records for dogs and make the 
records available for APHIS inspection. In addition to the identification of the animal, complete medical records must 
include the names of all vaccines and treatments administered and the dates of administration. Correct by: August 4, 
2026. 
 
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
